comment: v2 of phil-cello for the Intonalogy handoff rebuild (2026-08): forte ONLY
(the v1 fortissimo/1s fallback patterns produced a mixed-dynamic set with
qualitatively divergent samples: G2/B2/F3 shipped fortissimo because the
forte takes went red under fixed-phase seam validation), seamLagRefine on
(rescues vibrato-FM pairs by snapping b to the residual-minimizing lag;
forte G2 goes 3 -> 24 valid pairs), and xfadeResidualDbMax tightened
-10 -> -14 because Intonalogy holds tuning drones for many seconds and
wrap artifacts that pass at -10 are audible on long holds. 15_forte
covers C2-C6 chromatically with zero gaps, so pickSamples can shift the
spine to a neighboring note instead of ever mixing dynamics.
